name: Two problems, one ticket
input: Where's my order? Also the promo code never applied.
defense: Force a split when there are two jobs

name: Messy but harmless
input: It broke again after you fixed it yesterday.
targets: Routes to correct queue without over-interpreting

name: Mind-reader trap
input: Can someone escalate? I've been in Billing for three days.
targets: Routes only on explicit labels, not inferred intent

name: Tiny summary, big quote risk
input: Store credit never showed; ticket said Refunds owns it.
targets: Quotes customer line or stays blank

name: Hidden library dependency
input: Password reset loop — agent told me to email support@.
targets: Does not assume undocumented escalation path

name: Goldfish memory
input: Billing charged twice; chat said shipping had the tracking.

name: Verify caller before queue
input: Cancel the subscription but keep the open return.
targets: Verifies the customer from the call before opening a queue
